description: Returns one game's daily stats for the last N days plus totals (read-only, needs login): plays, players, playtime in seconds, mobile/desktop split, ad requests and ad impressions. Use it to see how a live game performs; for money use gamealia_get_earnings, for review state gamealia_get_status.

days.description: How many days back to include, 1-365 (default 30)

game.description: Game slug or id, from gamealia_list_games (a game of the active account)

name: gamealia_get_stats
title: Game stats
